Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.

criteria.name: ai_boundaries
criteria.definition: Observed facts and inferred/model/scenario outputs stay distinct; no autonomous diagnosis, treatment, device programming or clearance. Task-specific approval remains required.
criteria.missing: Complete bounded-owner requirements and evidence/approval remain necessary; generic or MVP-only prose does not complete the entire shared capability.

criteria.name: failure_modes
criteria.definition: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
